voice_lines: E20 is twenty percent ethanol and eighty percent petrol. It's what most pumps in India sell now.
Check your fuel lid. An E20 sticker means your car is made for it. Most cars made from April 2023 are.
Mileage drops a little: about one to two percent in E20 ready cars, and a few percent in older ones.
Older car? Ask your service centre to check rubber parts like fuel hoses at the next service. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
E20 petrol: what it means for your car ⛽

• E20 = 20% ethanol + 80% petrol
• Look for the E20 sticker on your fuel lid. Most cars made from April 2023 are E20-ready.
• Mileage: roughly 1-2% lower in E20-ready cars, a few % in older cars (approximate, varies by car)
• Older car? Ask the service centre to check rubber parts like fuel hoses and seals at the next service.
